protocol.py: 8 biology problems (4 errors, 1 warning, 3 notes).

1. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A2 in slot 2: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 64:  p20_single.aspirate(10.5, reservoir["A2"])  # water
   At line 64 the p20_single_gen2 draws 10.5 ul from water (well A2 in slot 2) with its tip
   1 mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 184 ul, which in this NEST 12
   Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.87 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air
   (this line did it 13 times, after 11 times in the liquid; 136 ul of air in all). The
   simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 13 wells filled from these
   draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A2 in slot 2.
   Also reached 13 other wells: wells A12, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7 and 5 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
